summary: Initializes a physics/collision shape structure: stores a discriminator word a2 at this+0x8, the subtype constant 3 at this+0x1C and the external data pointer a3 at this+0x20. Builds a local six-dword array of precomputed float bit patterns and stores it together with the inverse-mass scalar 15.0 via CollisionInvMassStore, then bulk-sets six more float fields via F_6FieldBulkSetter. If a4 is non-zero, delegates to ShortComputation_e770(this, a4, 0); otherwise returns a4.

operations.description: Store the discriminator word a2 at this+0x8.
Store the subtype/kind constant 3 at this+0x1C.
Store the external data pointer a3 at this+0x20.
Build the local six-dword constant array v6 from precomputed float bit patterns.
Store the inverse-mass scalar 15.0 and the constant float array into the collision data: CollisionInvMassStore(15.0, v6).
Bulk-set six float fields in the collision data: F_6FieldBulkSetter(0, 1085667584, 0, 1078362112, 0, 1072693248).
Copy a4 into result as the default return value.
If a4 is non-zero, take the continuation path.
Conditional continuation computation: ShortComputation_e770(this, a4, 0); its result becomes the return value.
Return result: a4 on the skipped-continuation path, or the result of ShortComputation_e770 otherwise.
